name: Pretty Crisis 2nd
source:
Princess of the neighboring country Olivese arrives to the country where knight Rudel leaves. He needs to collect a certain amount of money to be able to send her back.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
鄰國奧利維斯的公主來到了魯德爾騎士離開的國家。他需要湊夠一定的錢才能把她送回來。
